context: Reference review: parallelStream with forEach mutating a shared HashMap is unsafe; collector-owned accumulation is the correct stream chain.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear decision.

checklist.name: Rejects proposed change
checklist.description: Clearly says the proposed parallelStream change should not be accepted.

checklist.name: Catches shared HashMap race
checklist.description: Explains that parallel forEach mutates a shared HashMap and can race, corrupt state, or lose entries.

checklist.name: Rejects unjustified parallelism
checklist.description: Notes that no CPU-heavy stateless work or measured benefit justifies parallelStream here.

checklist.name: Suggests collector-owned accumulation
checklist.description: Recommends a sequential stream with Collectors.toMap(Shipment::id, Function.identity(), merge) or another collector-owned accumulation approach.
